answer: Plant canaries in the grading queue. Each epoch the protocol slips a few answers of known quality into graders' seats, some junk and some strong, indistinguishable from real work. A sybil ring that props itself up by rubber-stamping its own answers will stamp the junk canary a 3 too, and each miss spirals its grader weight down until its votes count for nothing. It's like hiding a sable brush in a bin of ferrous wire: anyone truly looking spots it. Assumption: canaries are written fresh and rotate, so rings can't memorize them.
